## Missingness Codes

The following dropdown provides a reference for interpreting special numeric codes used to indicate missing or skipped responses in the dataset.

<details>
<summary style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 18px; color: #2a5caa; cursor: pointer;">Click to view missingness codes</summary>

<br>

| Code | Description           |
|------|-----------------------|
| -1   | Skipped by respondent |
| -3   | No response recorded  |
| -6   | Survey timeout        |
| -8   | Consent withdrawn     |
| -9   | Other missing reason  |

</details>
